No local response upload or send before explicit action
Live service consent read after process recreation

verified: Real Settings toggle ignores an old unversioned true boolean
Explicit local opt-in and opt-out persist ordinary relaunch
Two real SQLite workspace identities retain independent choices

boundary: UI uses ordinary production views and real HouseholdModel/HouseholdService with a strictly guarded test-build-only .invalid transport. No production authentication or business-authority bypass.
Canonical household/week uniqueness, tenant isolation, current consent and verified Apple billing/refund behavior are separately covered by the real PostgreSQL/HTTP measurement acceptance tests.
AccessibilityFocusState and scope/token guarded focus routing are implemented. UI tests verify the resulting visible anchor; a manual VoiceOver session is not claimed.
The tested source is the successful shared acceptance base plus the four recorded F09 overlays, not an assertion that unrelated later source changes were included.
